newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Police blow up case near Israeli envoy's home.
newsitem.headline: Police blow up case near Israeli envoy's home.

text.p: Police sealed off Brussels' main shopping street on Thursday and blew up a suspect suitcase outside the residence of Israel's former ambassador to Belgium.
"There is a bomb alert. We have closed part of Avenue Louise," a police spokesman told Reuters.
The suitcase turned out to contain only old clothes and washing-up cloths.
A spokeswoman at the Israeli embassy said the suitcase was immediately in front of the residence of Ambassador Victor Harel who retired a month ago and is currently in Israel.
